According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), the most widely accepted estimate is around 50 million deaths. However, some studies have suggested that the number may be higher, reaching up to 100 million.
It is important to note that these figures are estimates and may vary depending on the source. The pandemic had a devastating impact on the world, killing more people than World War I.
